meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: Claude 会用迪特·拉姆斯的十条设计准则检查设计:逐项打分并附证据,给出“新设计、改进或重做”的结论,再生成一段可直接交给 /make-plan 的计划提示词。整个评估结果会写成数份文件,存入项目的 DESIGN-IS-日期 文件夹。
howto.when: 当你说“审计这个设计”“设计评审”“design audit”等,或请它按 Rams 准则点评设计并引导出计划时触发。常规 UI 代码审查、纯文案修改和尚未成品的构思阶段不会触发。

say.text: 审计这个界面:主按钮的样式和间距有没有问题?
say.note: 它会按十条准则给界面打分并指出改进点。

say.text: 用拉姆斯十原则评审我的首页设计,然后给一份计划。
say.note: 它会生成评审文件,并产出 /make-plan 交接提示。

say.text: 检查这版 UI 是否符合 Rams,结论要能导向重做方案。
say.note: 它会判定改进还是重做,并给出后续计划。

howto.what_en: Claude audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each with evidence, decides an outcome (NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN), and hands off a ready-to-run prompt to /make-plan. It produces several artifact files stored in the project.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a design audit/review against Rams, e.g. "audit this design", "design review", "design audit", etc. Routine UI code reviews, pure copy edits, and pre-design ideation do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Audit this interface: are the primary button's style and spacing okay?
say_en.note: Scores the UI against the ten principles and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: Review my homepage design against Rams' ten principles, then give me a plan.
say_en.note: Writes audit files and emits a /make-plan handoff prompt.

say_en.text: Check this UI against Rams; I want a plan that could lead to a redesign.
say_en.note: Decides REFINE or REDESIGN and hands off a follow-up plan.
